ISS.name: International Space Station (ISS)
ISS.rackFocus: Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR) & Microgravity Science Glovebox (MSG)
ISS.primaryHazard: Diffusion-limited spherical flames; cool flame re-ignition (FLEX/CFI); soot accumulation in dead zones.
ISS.suppressionProtocol: CO₂ fire extinguishers + Fine Water Mist port injectors; complete module ventilation isolation.

MOON.name: Artemis Lunar Base Camp (Shackleton Rim)
MOON.rackFocus: Exploration Atmosphere Habitat & Surface Pressurized Rover
MOON.primaryHazard: Elevated 34% O₂ Exploration Atmosphere drastically lowers material ignition thresholds. Low gravity creates an unstable buoyant plume (ACME CFI-G) that spreads faster than in 1g.
MOON.suppressionProtocol: Rapid partial depressurization (<5.0 psi) + Nitrogen purge cascade. Avoid fine water mist if electro-dust risk is elevated.

ARTEMIS.name: Lunar Gateway & Artemis Deep Space Transit
ARTEMIS.rackFocus: HALO (Habitation and Logistics Outpost) & Orion Cabin
ARTEMIS.primaryHazard: Elevated O₂ (30%) under strict freefall conditions. Fire spreads rapidly along ventilation airflow lines without natural convection self-limiting.
ARTEMIS.suppressionProtocol: Automated Cygnus-heritage Saffire rapid-damping dampers + high-pressure water mist injectors.

SUIT.name: EVA Spacewalk (Quest Airlock)
SUIT.rackFocus: Extravehicular Mobility Unit Secondary Oxygen Pack & PLSS
SUIT.primaryHazard: Pure 100% O₂ at 4.3 psi (29.6 kPa). Standard flame-resistant materials burn vigorously in pure oxygen if ignited by static electricity or mechanical friction.
SUIT.suppressionProtocol: Immediate emergency suit nitrogen purge cascade + emergency airlock ingress.

MARS.name: Mars Surface Habitat & Mars Ascent Vehicle (MAV)
MARS.rackFocus: Martian Surface Base & Fuel ISRU Plant
MARS.primaryHazard: Moderate gravity plume creates strong upward flame elongation. Perchlorate dust residues on suits could act as severe chemical oxidizers if ignited.
MARS.suppressionProtocol: Martian CO₂ atmospheric gas compression blanket purge + solid-state electric field dampers (ACME E-FIELD).
